name: Cloutly
oneLiner: Review and customer-messaging platform for multi-location service businesses: it asks customers for reviews by text and email, gathers reviews and messages in one inbox with AI reply drafts, and turns reviews into location-level insight, priced per location.
bestFor: Multi-location service and hospitality businesses that want review requests triggered by their POS or booking system and a shared review inbox at a published per-location price.

customers.name: Merivale, Sorsi e Morsi and Francesca's
customers.note: named as restaurants that manage their reviews in Cloutly

features: Review request campaigns by text and email, triggered when a bill closes in Square or Clover (or by Mindbody, Zenoti, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Xero and Zapier); follow-ups stop once the review lands and recent reviewers are skipped
Review QR codes and links for walk-in guests, and video testimonials (Essentials and up)
One inbox for reviews from Google and Facebook, and 39 review sites from Essentials, alongside Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, texts and email, filterable by location
Draft with AI writes a reply from the review itself in a Friendly, Professional or Playful tone; nothing goes out until you send it
Ask (Growth): plain-English questions over your reviews, answered with exact counts and the reviews behind them, plus a location scorecard
Signals for hospitality: negative mentions counted against ten hospitality themes per restaurant, switched on by the Cloutly team
Growth plan: competitor analysis, staff leaderboard, listings management (hours, phone and address published to Google and Facebook) and AI search visibility in ChatGPT and Gemini
Website review widgets and auto-sharing to social media; REST API on every plan; white-label option for agencies

pricing.text: Per location per month, billed monthly in USD: Starter $39 (Google and Facebook only, 50 SMS credits), Essentials $55 (39 review sites, 100 SMS credits), Growth $69 (200 SMS credits, competitor tracking, listings, Ask). Yearly billing is paid upfront with a month free. Enterprise is priced after a pilot; ten or more locations go through a rollout call. 14-day free trial, no credit card. Prices exclude tax.

notes: Plans changed since the last check (Starter, Essentials, Growth, Enterprise; old prices $27/$63-69/$73-79 replaced): USD prices come from the schema.org offers in the cloutly.com/plans page source (AUD 49/69/89, GBP 29/39/49), as the visible price fields load by script. No dated 2025-2026 product news found. Swyftx is no longer on cloutly.com and was dropped. G2 shows a 5.0 from a single review, so no rating is used. Magic Response is now called Draft with AI. The site says 39 review sites (earlier '40+').
pros: Published per-location prices and a 14-day trial with no credit card
Requests go out automatically when a bill closes in Square or Clover, and each review is tied to the location the guest visited
Reviews, texts and social DMs share one inbox, with AI reply drafts in three tones
Ask and Signals turn reviews into counts by theme and location
REST API on every plan, plus integrations with Square, Clover, Mindbody, HubSpot and Klaviyo

cons.text: Starter covers only Google and Facebook reviews; the other review sites start on Essentials
Competitor tracking, listings management, Ask and AI search visibility are only on Growth
Texts draw on a monthly SMS allowance per location (50, 100 or 200); more needs a pay-as-you-go pack
Ten or more locations go through a rollout call and a custom price
Built for service businesses in many industries; restaurant themes (Signals) are switched on by the Cloutly team on request
